lemma cleanse : ∃ α : Selection S, Materializes (C:=C) X α s.kernel.spin := by
  obtain ⟨V⟩ := OS.realization s.kernel timeAxis
  obtain ⟨A,hA⟩ := H.first h V
  have hp : Stall X V A f := H.sale h V A hA
  have hv : Steady V := fun x i => inert V s.kernel X.turns h.motion _ x
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hp.characters
  obtain ⟨R,hR⟩ := OS.Ground.resolution A X.turns h.motion s.kernel u hu
  have ht := hp.drives R hR
  obtain ⟨p,B⟩ := ht.emits
  -- choose fixed α chambers before selecting uniqueness. Denote D.
  let D (i : R.X) : Chamber (p i) timeAxis := Classical.choice (OS.realization (B.loci i) _)
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := ht.horizon B D
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Cluster.selects A D q hq s.kernel hv B.loci hR B.reads
  obtain ⟨W,hW⟩ := ht.bags B i (D i)
  refine ⟨⟨V,A,R,p,i,D i,W⟩,h,hA,hv,hR,B.reads,B.loci,B.translations,fun j d => ?_,B.incl,B.deriv,B.fluxes,hW,hi⟩
  obtain ⟨x,T,H'⟩ := s.corrected d
  exact Retain.lift_detect T H' A R (hp.funds d x T H') hR (B.reads j) (B.loci j).laws.toSymmetric (B.sees j)

proof_context.conclusion: `cleanse` assembles the `Selection` with `Materializes` from the resolution, the phase tables `p`, the chambers and the ground selection.

structure Selection.Certificate {P : DiffPlan S} (R : S.Rotation) (J : S.Stress) (C : Selection S) : Prop where
  lengths : Spread.Laws C.unselected P
  still : ∀ x : C.room.D, ∀ i, C.room.flow.U i x = x
  decomposition : C.space.Out
  chosen (i) : C.space.receives (C.ensemble i) i
  states (i) : (C.ensemble i).Hierarchy
  sym i : R.Oriented (C.ensemble i)
  retains i d : (C.ensemble i).null d=S.null d
  coordinates i : P.Inclusions (C.ensemble i)
  calculus i : P.Derivatives (C.ensemble i)
  flux i : Table.StressLaws (C.ensemble i) J P.deriv R.lie
  goes : Spread.Laws C.slabs P
  heat : C.leaps.UniqueHeat

proof_context.conclusion: Per-phase hierarchy, orientation, null-space equality, inclusions, derivatives, stress laws, plus `decomposition`, `chosen` and `heat`.

theorem barycenter (T : R.X → Table L) (hv : R.Out) (ht : ∀ i, R.receives (T i) i) (he : S.Homogeneous)
    (q : L.Word) (h : distinct q) : (∫ i, (T i).expect q ∂R.μ) = S.expect q := by
  obtain ⟨t,d,Hd⟩ := place_exists h
  simp_rw [show ∀ i, (T i).expect q = _ from fun i => ht i q h t d Hd]
  rw [hv.ground,P.insertValue]; exact invariance he h t

proof_context.conclusion: The mixture formula: the integral of the phase values equals S.expect.
